Definition: Naphtali, a son of Jacob, with the tribe descended from him, and its territory
BiblicalUsage: Naphtali = "wrestling"; n pr m; 1) the 5th son of Jacob and the 2nd by Bilhah the handmaid of Rachel; 2) the tribe descended from Naphtali the son of Jacob; n pr loc; 3) the territory assigned to the tribe of Naphtali
